home.eyebrow: The next card is anyone’s guess
home.title: Good friends.
home.description: Klemps is a party card game of luck and a little nerve. Gather your friends, guess the cards, and see who gets it right.
home.note: Pass the screen. Take your chances.

rules.intro: Add your players, choose a difficulty, then take turns making four guesses.

rounds.RED_BLACK: Guess the colour of your first card.
rounds.HIGH_LOW: Will your second card rank higher or lower than your first?
rounds.INSIDE_OUTSIDE: Will your third card fall between the first two ranks, or outside them?
rounds.SUIT: Guess the suit of your fourth card: hearts, diamonds, spades or clubs.

rules.outcome: Guess right? Give out drinks. Guess wrong? Take them. The amount depends on the round and difficulty.
rules.note: Keep it friendly. Alcohol is optional.
